SCENE: The harbour wall, dawn
Narration: Morning comes grey and quiet. The boat is not there.
ON SCREEN: Mara (tired, hopeful)
AMBIENCE: gulls over the harbour
MARA (sad): I waited all night.
CG: an empty boat drifting beyond the pier
Narration: Far out, a hull turns over in the swell.
END CG
MARA (quiet): Someone will come.
